= CSS-in-JS libraries

Libraries for writing CSS directly in JavaScript or JSX, usually with
zero-runtime or near-zero-runtime output.

* https://stitches.dev/[Stitches]
* https://typicode.github.io/mistcss/[MistCSS]
* https://linaria.dev/[Linaria]
* https://github.com/mui/pigment-css[mui/pigment-css]
